Is Coffee & Contracts a done-for-you service?
No. Coffee & Contracts is a DIY template library. You customize Canva templates, generate or edit captions with the built-in AI, and post or schedule everything yourself in Instagram.
Does Coffee & Contracts include video editing?
No. Coffee & Contracts provides Reel scripts and trending audio suggestions, but no video production or editing. You film and edit everything yourself.
Which platforms does Coffee & Contracts support?
Coffee & Contracts provides templates formatted for Instagram and Facebook only. No content for LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, or X.
Does Coffee & Contracts have public reviews?
Coffee & Contracts has no public Trustpilot profile, no Google Business listing, and no BBB accreditation. There is no way to verify customer satisfaction through independent review platforms.
